name_input: VISHAL SURGICAL EQUIPMENT CO. PVT. LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'vishal-surgical-equipment-company-private-limited' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/vishal-surgical-equipment-company-private-limited) shows 'Total Shipments 726 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-21', but every visible row is an INBOUND record with the company as BUYER, e.g. '2026-02-06 | FLEXBAR MACHINE CORPORATION DBA MEDIFLEX | VISHAL SURGICAL EQUIPMENT COMPANY PRIVATE LIMITED | STRONGARM COMBO SYSTEM ... RETRACTORS INSTRUMENTS AND APPLIANCES USED IN SURGICAL MEDIC- | NEW YORK JOHN F K, UNITED STATES | CHENNAI AIR CARGO ACC INMAA4, India | 90189025 | 7352147'. No outbound/export row with an Indian port of loading and a foreign destination was seen. Source counter: page claims 726 shipments; rows actually rendered = 5 (all imports).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. Searches for the company name returned only unrelated results (Bing ignored the quoted phrase; DuckDuckGo/Google/Searx endpoints timed out or returned 429), and ZaubaCorp returned HTTP 403. No domestic supply record was observed, so this is recorded as unknown rather than none_found.
note: Direction of trade is the key finding: the 726 customs records on ImportKey are IMPORT records — the company appears as consignee/buyer receiving surgical retractors (HS 90189025) from Flexbar Machine Corp/Mediflex (USA), antimicrobial PVC sheets (HS 39204900) from Bioclad Ltd (UK) and PVC flooring/welding rods (HS 39181090, 39162099) from Gerflor Asia (China/HK). Registered address shown: MELARAM COMPLEX 23 WALLERS ROAD (Chennai area; ports Chennai Sea INMAA1, Chennai Air Cargo INMAA4, Tuglakabad ICD). This is consistent with a surgical-equipment importer/distributor and interior-fit-out trader, not an exporter. Declared HS 901890 is plausible for the surgical-instrument line but the company's own trade is inbound, so no HS correction is asserted here. No export bill-of-lading with date, destination and B/L number was found; per Rule 5 the verdict is 'следов экспортных поставок не найдено'. Domestic supply evidence is genuinely unavailable (not disproven) — revenue and export volume: null, not public in the sources reachable. Trader status should be treated as trader/distributor (imports for Indian market), not manufacturer. Caveat: volza, eximpedia, trademo and importgenius all returned HTTP 403 and search engines were unreachable, so this rests on a single free ImportKey view; a paid export-database check is advisable before finalising.
